 ----Respondents For Appellant(s) : Mr. Anuj Sahlot.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. A.R. Choudhary, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 20/07/2023

The instant appeal has been filed under Section 14 A SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act on behalf of the appellant, who is in custody in connection with F.I.R. No.451/2022,
registered at Police Station Surajpol, District Udaipur for the offences under Sections 376(2)(N) IPC and Sections 3(2)(v), 3(1)(w)(i) of the SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against the order dated 26.06.2023 passed by the learned Special Judge Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases Udaipur whereby, the bail application preferred under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the appellant was rejected.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned public prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
[CRLAS-1287/2023] Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the appellant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Drawing attention of the Court towards challan submitted by the Investigating Agency before the competent criminal court after making thorough investigation into the matter, learned counsel for the appellant submitted that prosecutrix was in the consensual relationship with the present appellant since September, 2021.
Learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix developed consensual sexual relationship with the present appellant who is aged about 28 years out of her free will and volition.

Learned counsel submitted that the Sushil Kurmi @ Raj Gaur vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107607656/
1 prosecutrix who is aged about 20 years has falsely roped present appellant in a criminal case on turning relations between the appellant and prosecutrix strain.

entities.text: Sushil Kurmi @ Raj Gaur vs State Of Rajasthan
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Challan of the case has already been filed.

Lastly, it was submitted that the appellant is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-appellant.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the prayer for bail.

Having regard to the entirety of facts and circumstances as available on record and upon a consideration of the arguments advanced at the bar, this Court is of the opinion that the order rejecting the application for bail filed on behalf of the appellant, cannot be sustained and deserves to be set aside.
Consequently, the instant appeal is allowed.

The impugned order dated 26.06.2023 passed by the learned Special Judge Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) (3 of 3)
[CRLAS-1287/2023] Act Cases Udaipur is set aside.

It is ordered that the accused- appellant Sushil Kurmi @ Raj Gaur S/o Lakhan Singh Kurmi arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.451/2022,
registered at Police Station Surajpol, District Udaipur shall be released on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- and two surety bonds of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 305-Prashant/-
